'''Ofe owerri''' is a popular Igbo [[Cookbook:soup|soup]] indigenous to the people of Owerri, Nigeria. It is made from either ugu or okazi [[Cookbook:vegetable|vegetable]]s. Many different recipes and variations are possible.

==Ingredients==
* 1 [[Cookbook:Kilogram|kg]] assorted [[Cookbook:Meat|meat]] ([[Cookbook:Beef|beef]], [[Cookbook:Goat|goat]], cow [[Cookbook:Tripe|tripe]], etc.) 
* 4–6 [[Cookbook:Dehydrated Broth|seasoning cubes]] 
* 3–4 [[Cookbook:Cup|cups]] [[Cookbook:Water|water]] 
* 500 [[Cookbook:Gram|g]] [[Cookbook:Dryfish|dryfish]], smoked fish, or [[Cookbook:Stockfish|stockfish]]
* 1 cup [[Cookbook:Taro Root|cocoyam]] paste
* 1 cup [[Cookbook:Palm Oil|palm oil]]
* 3 [[Cookbook:Tablespoon|tablespoons]] [[Cookbook:Ground Crayfish|ground crayfish]]
* 2 tablespoons [[Cookbook:Ogiri|ogiri]] (fermented melon seed paste)
* Fresh [[Cookbook:Bell Pepper|bell pepper]] or [[Cookbook:Chiles|chile pepper]]
* 1 cup [[Cookbook:Afang|okazi]] or [[Cookbook:Ashanti Pepper|uziza]] leaves, thinly [[Cookbook:Slicing|sliced]]
* 2 [[Cookbook:Cup|cups]] [[Cookbook:Fluted Pumpkin|ugu]] leaves, [[Cookbook:Chopping|chopped]]

==Equipment==
* Cooking pot
* Sieve
* Stirring spoon
* Kitchen [[Cookbook:Knife|knife]]
* [[Cookbook:Cutting Board|Chopping board]]
* Bowls
* [[Cookbook:Mortar and Pestle|Mortar and pestle]]

==Procedure==
#Clean the meats and dryfish, and cut into pieces.
#[[Cookbook:Simmering|Simmer]] the meat with seasoning cubes and water in a pot until tender. Add stockfish and dried fish.
#Stir in the cocoyam paste to thicken the soup, making sure it's well incorporated.
#Stir in the palm oil, crayfish, ogiri, and pepper. Simmer for 5–10 minutes.
#Add okazi leaves, and simmer for 3 minutes.
#Stir in ugu leaves, and simmer for 2–3 minutes.
#Taste and adjust seasoning. Serve hot with pounded yam or fufu.
